checkpoint.name: Alpha 2.0 - Automation directives
checkpoint.summary: Continued the automation arc after local companion behavior and milestone tempo bonuses. Added player-selectable automation directives so automation can be steered toward growth, harvest, or supplies without offline progress or expensive per-frame simulation.

previousSessionCommits.message: Focus bee hive pollination around placement

checkpoint.note: This handoff file itself was created after the deployment commit and may be committed separately as docs-only metadata.

implementedThisSession: Added a bounded AutomationScheduler so sprinkler, companion, and mutation systems run on staggered 250 ms jobs instead of doing unnecessary per-frame work.
Made Field Mouse, Meadow Rabbit, and Bee Hive focus around their placed world-object tile instead of acting globally.
Added Forager Trails as a Seed Shop upgrade that improves Field Mouse and Meadow Rabbit action cadence/radius.
Added automation HUD status text showing active automation, boosts, tempo tier, and current directive.
Updated credits to show developer sensiburner.
Added automation milestone tempo bonuses derived from existing owned automation units. This is pure derived state; no save schema or extra loops were needed.
Added save version 7 and automationDirectiveId with migration fallback to balanced.
Added AutomationDirectiveSystem with Balanced, Growth, Harvest, and Supplies directives.
Added an Auto panel that appears once at least one automation unit exists. The panel lets the player choose a directive and saves the choice.
Growth directive biases sprinkler and companions toward regrowth, pollination, and field readiness.
Harvest directive uses bounded local/sample scoring to prefer better grown patches for automated touches.
Supplies directive nudges seed/gold-producing automation odds upward.
Kept all directive behavior action-time only: no offline progress, no pathfinding, no continuous scans.

designNotes: The user explicitly does not want offline progress.
The user cares a lot about smooth performance. Keep automation bounded, tick-based, and avoid broad per-frame scans.
Automation should gradually make the game less hands-on, but still let the player steer it.
The current directive implementation intentionally uses small local scans or bounded samples only when an automation action fires.
The right-side UI stack now dynamically shows Auto once automation exists and Journal once Field Journal exists.
The stress/perf overlay can visually cover the Auto panel in narrow stress mode; normal play does not show the overlay.
knownCaveats: Directive balance is prototype-level and should be tuned after a fresh-save playtest.
Auto panel is functional but visually plain compared with asset-rich shop/gameplay elements.
Harvest scoring is intentionally simple and bounded; it prefers value but does not simulate global optimization.
Growth directive can water regrowing tiles, which changes sprinkler behavior from only touching grown grass under that directive.
Vercel/Phaser bundle-size warnings remain expected for now.

recommendedNextSteps.details: Check whether Tiny Sprinkler, animal companions, Forager Trails, tempo milestones, and directives unlock at satisfying times.
Examples: own 2/4/7 automation units, trigger 50 automated touches, use each directive, or earn supplies via automation.
Small panel readouts like unit count, tempo tier, current directive, and recent automated actions would help players understand why numbers move.
Consider icon/symbol treatments for Balanced, Growth, Harvest, and Supplies. Asset brief can be made later if needed.
